replies.author: Kamika242
replies.text:
becomeparmesan

I just installed the app via Aurora, but I have Play Services with network permission only installed. It work's so far, for me in guest mode, as I don't have a Ryanair account. I think it would also work without Play Services, but then without push notifications. The app opens a connection to "firebaseinstallations.googleapis.com" to register for push notifications, "firebaseremoteconfig.googleapis.com" for remote in-app configuration and notifications, "graph.facebook.com" for spy services and all other connections are made directly to Ryanair service apis.

replies.author: veryimportantplasticbag
replies.text:
https://help.ryanair.com/hc/en-gb/articles/39758330098577-What-about-passengers-who-don-t-have-a-smartphone-or-tablet

Simply go to the counter and tell them that you don't have digital boarding pass.

They could let customers to download the boarding pass, but they want to milk them.

Edited for clarification: You can book a ticket and also check-in on their website. The app is required only to get the boarding pass.

replies.author: becomeparmesan
replies.text:
Thanks, both.

Indeed, the crucial part seems to check in online and then you can request the printed boarding pass with whatever reason. Let's see how much resistance I will get.

replies.author: becomeparmesan
replies.text: Update after the flight: you can indeed just say your battery died and can get the printed boarding pass. No arguing, no comments. Just remember to check-in online before that.

replies.author: andrej567
replies.text: becomeparmesan Ok. I had printed boarding passes but the scanner did not accept them. I was told it does not work anymore. There was no time to start a discussion.. I had the same printed as on cellphone. No idea. weird.

replies.author: Foggy
replies.text: andrej567 I wonder if that's airport dependent? I was flying Jet2 from a Greek airport and the scanners accepted my downloaded PDF even though Jet2 say you have to install their app. The PDF had a rectangular 2D code while I saw online some people saying it only works with square codes. I expect this is set by the airport equipment rather than the airline (although at hubs it's more plausible there is airline specific equipment).
